verdict.rationale: Mastra Code has a reference page for embedding it programmatically, so an API-reference story applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the static reference and llms.txt/markdown docs do not amount to an interactive, runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
